node.title: The Map and The Flow
node.reading:
Informational friction as a systems problem — why a representation that governs a flow it cannot fully observe tends to deform that flow, under conditions this paper makes explicit. Stated for systems in general, human or not.

Document Status — Foundational Working Paper · Paper 1 · Series: Informational Friction (a systems theory)

The title and section titles are working titles. This is the anchor of the systems-theory series, which re-derives in pure systems terms — independent of whether the agents are human — the object behind three companion series: The Cost of Clarity (information theory), The Attribution Gap (economics), and Human Intelligence Debt (organizational theory). The forward forecasts (the Outlook) and the consolidated falsification battery are deferred to later papers in the series.

relations: A reframing intervention may change both the formal representation of work and the operating flow subsequently used to evaluate it.
El cambio de marco no siempre causa un cambio operativo; documentar la secuencia y alternativas causales.
Independent dependency and attribution records provide a concrete comparison for the distinction between found flow and declared representation.
Los logs también son parciales e instrumentales. La separación reduce circularidad, pero no convierte la traza técnica en verdad neutral ni prueba toda Informational Friction.
Cross-frame coherence is assessed against an independently specified upstream outcome, making the map–flow argument operational without equating every deviation with value.
No todo incumplimiento es coherencia y un objetivo del cliente puede ser inválido en un marco social o legal más amplio.
Operational tracking can close the loop between a process representation and the effects of decisions taken through it, rather than treating the diagram as a static description.
Una notación BPMN no demuestra causalidad ni garantiza que la captura observe todo el flujo.
Embedded field architecture can shorten corrective feedback between the operational flow and the representation used to change it.
La presencia en campo no da observabilidad total ni demuestra por sí sola causalidad o eliminación de fricción.
Reach-weighted latency can operationalize one aspect of informational friction, but the causal loss from a divergent map must still be separated from necessary waiting and other delays.
No se identifica algebraicamente F con la magnitud teórica ni se interpreta todo retraso como ineficiencia.
Narrative compression becomes operationally consequential when the simplified model is used as the control surface for decisions that depend on omitted conditions.
No toda simplificación es falsa ni toda divergencia produce el mismo daño; hay que observar la decisión y su efecto.
The preserved September synthesis records an earlier programme reading of the map–flow problem; its dated status should remain visible beside the current explanation.
El nombre del archivo no prueba que todas sus revisiones existieran el 22 de septiembre.
The programme bridge extends the map–flow reading while keeping analytical closure distinct from causal isolation and its provisional topology separate from established results.
No se afirma una distancia medida, una ley de conservación física ni una topología formal ya demostrada.
A certificate sufficient for one request need not remain sufficient when simultaneous requests consume the same underlying capacity.
El resultado es de un árbol finito construido; no establece que toda composición pierda información o falle materialmente.
For a complementary reading, see [The Map and the Flow](https://tegrity.ai/the-map-and-the-flow/).
